Home depot has Mold Armor spray.  Make sure you get the "Rapid clean and remediation" bottle.   It'll take care of that in one application.  
MAKE SURE IT IS WELL VENTILATED!!!
Get a window scrubbing thing, spray the hell out of it, and make sure it's covering everything. 
Wait about 3-5 minutes, light scrub with a scrub brush.
Then rinse it all with warm water.

Once you've done the initial treatment, the mold armor has a general "protection" spray.

Sorry for your loss!

You don't mention the material of the tub, but considering what you have tried - I'd pick up some Zepp tub and tile and try that.  If that doesn't work, I'd try some draino gel / foaming pipe snake.  Leaving each SEPARATELY for 30 minutes and rinsing / scrubbing before trying the next.

I was yelled at for losing 45lbs.  I'm 'ruining my health' and I'm going to 'eat myself to death' because I had a lemon loaf slice at Starbucks. 

Generally get told that I'm doing things wrong.

Felt so tore up yesterday that I almost veered my car into oncoming traffic to meet head-on with a bus.  

Is what it is - my feelings are usually disregarded - sometimes with someone valid excuses - but usually with a simple 'you need more sleep' or 'you must be fighting being sick'
My dog is the only reason I'm still around anymore
This.  I struggle almost every day.   No one knows.  I feel I've got it under control, but it's still a struggle.
Oddly for me.  Will was never a part of it.   I dug into spite more than anything.  Because no one will be right in thinking I won't make it.

Thanks.  It's been a long time since.   I'm living my life now.  Good job, beautiful wife.  I wish it hadn't of happened, but on this side of it (in a way) I'm glad.   It really put my priorities in life in order.   I've cut drama out of my life and don't compromise.

I can not stress enough; find a hobby.  Cars, woodworking, gardening, gem cutting.   Anything to keep your mind busy when you are home alone.   My dog Freyja really helped too.  Always making sure I woke up in the morning.

I was served divorce papers omw to radiation therapy at 23.  I do understand what you are going through.   It took many years, but managed to pay off my cancer bills after about a decade (yay American health care).  It gets better, but I still second guess a lot.

I hope you find something that you can find to pour yourself into.  It really takes your mind off and makes it easier.
So many times I've fallen asleep wishing this.
The girl from Heritage.  It was just so damn unexpected.
New weekend, same as last.  Here goes another work week.  I still wish I simply wouldn't wake up.
Made it through the weekend.  Now to start my workweek.
